name: Giant Scorpion

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scorpion makes two Claw attacks and one Sting attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two claws.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft., one creature Grappled by the scorpion. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is instead stable but Poisoned for 1 hour and Unconscious while Poisoned this way.

description: Giant scorpions burrow beneath desert sand or cavern floors, erupting to seize prey with grasping claws before delivering a venomous, often lethal, sting.
